editor.advanced.alt_image_side_note: Switch which side the image appears on from one passage to the next, rather than always the same side.
editor.advanced.big_text_note: It's not recommended to use this setting unless you have eyesight issues that require it.
editor.advanced.dedicate_pd: Dedicate your own content to the public domain
editor.advanced.design_link_note: This allows others to print additional copies of your design and/or customize it (they won't be able to modify your copy).
editor.advanced.design_link_warning: Disabling this will prevent people from sharing the design, printing additional copies, and using it in other useful ways. We do not recommend disabling it unless you are including material from third-parties that is not openly licensed.
editor.advanced.emphasis_note: Italicize questions and embolden exclamations in picture story passages, enlarged and colored.
editor.advanced.flip_edge: My printer doesn't allow "flip on short edge"
editor.advanced.flip_edge_note: If your printer can only flip on long edge (which is the default for double-sided portrait documents) then this setting will output a portrait PDF with alternating rotation which will look correct once printed double-sided.
editor.advanced.hyphenate_note: Break long words across lines with a hyphen where needed.
editor.advanced.image_painted: Painted (padded, with a painted brushstroke edge)
editor.advanced.images_note: Applies to every passage image in the document.
editor.advanced.pd_learn_more: Learn more about public domain dedication.
editor.advanced.pd_note: This ensures your creation will be able to be shared and printed by others without restriction.
editor.advanced.poetry_outdent: Skip initial indent in poetry books
editor.advanced.poetry_outdent_note: Skip the first level of indentation of poetry when the whole book is mostly poetry (Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah…). Reduces line wrapping and improves readability.
editor.advanced.running_disabled_note: Enable page numbers and/or book & chapter name under Features to configure these.
editor.advanced.story_grid: Grid of 4 images & passages per page
editor.advanced.titlepages_note: Applies to every title page in the document.
